Here's an extremely uncommon form of S. purpurea ssp. venosa. I've never seen any pictures of S. purpurea venosa f. heterophylla in nature-has anyone else seen it?

I've seen a few S. rosea f. heterophyllas being called venosa f. heterophylla, which is an easy mistake to make. I've also seen hybrids labeled as S. purpurea venosa f. heterophylla as well. However, the ones pictured below are the real deal:
